architect.note: Alcala Architects: models on plinths, drafting tables.

auto_parts.note: Same as parts; all props built.

bakery.note: Bread on the back wall, cakes in the case.

bank.note: Pilot set (com_bank). Teller line + queue stanchions + 2 officer desks.

bar.note: Mirror behind the bar; no plants.

bikes.note: No room recipe today (kind missing from room_gen).

books.note: Reading nook with a chair and lamp in the bigger rooms.

broker.note: Bay Boatworks harbour office: charts, brokerage desk.

cafe.note: Warm wood; one plant at most.

canteen.note: Industrial canteen: drop the potted plant from its recipe.

car_sales.note: Bridge Motors: desks + one display car (stand-in: display_plinth, or a game vehicle mesh if the vehicle LOD fits).

church.note: Aisle down the middle, pews both sides facing the altar.

classroom.note: Ridgeview Elementary: rows of small desks face the board.

clinic.note: Clinical: waiting row facing reception, one exam bay.

clothes.note: Large ones: zone men/women with racks; mirror by the fitting room.

coffee.note: Small walk-in: counter, a ledge with stools, one table.

community.note: Ridge Senior Center: a lounge, not a theatre.

court.note: Courtroom: bench at the back on a step, gallery benches face it.

diner.note: Counter with stools + booths along the window.

er.note: Emergency department: triage desk + curtained bays.

fast_food.note: No house decor; branded and wipe-clean.

fish_counter.note: Drop the potted plant from its recipe; ice display is the key gap.

florist.note: The one kind where many plants are right; drinks_fridge stands in for a flower cooler.

freight_office.note: Counter + racking behind; parcel_scale is built.

gallery.note: 351 m²: sculptures on plinths, frames at 1.5 m.

gym.note: 328 m² with one bench type: cardio and dumbbells are needed.

hall.note: Community hall: folding tables, a stage at the far end.

joinery.note: Hill Joinery / Lane Cabinetmakers are tagged keys; dress them as wood shops, show pieces on display_table, sideboard or credenza as finished work.

law.note: Bookcases on every wall; client chairs face the desk.

library.note: Rows of bookcase, reading tables, a lounge corner.

lobby.note: Tower lobby: reception counter facing the door, lounge group, directory by the lifts.

lube.note: Waiting room + counter of a quick lube.

office.note: Desks in pairs facing each other or the window; one plant.

panaderia.note: Self-serve rack is the signature; build it.

pawn.note: House decor as stock for sale.

post_office.note: Story shop; queue lane with stanchions, PO boxes are the signature.

print.note: The printer is the gap that makes it read.

realty.note: Window listing boards are the signature.

rec_center.note: Hill Rec Center; all gym props built.

restaurant.note: Tables set at 0.6 m per seat; one vase per table max.

takeout.note: Tiny front: counter, menu, a bench to wait.

taproom.note: Concrete + kegs; remove potted_plant from its extras.

taqueria.note: Salsa bar is in the room recipe but has no prop.

thrift.note: The one place a jumble of house decor is right.

trade_counter.note: Drop the potted plant from its extras.

transit.note: Ferry / bus tickets: booth + queue + benches facing the board.

uniform.note: Linen service; drop the potted plant from its extras.

vintage.note: Crownado Vintage: jewellery cases plus a rail of vintage clothes.

wine.note: Shop, not a bar: no stools.

workwear.note: Drop the potted plant from its extras.

reception_desk.kinds: lobby, clinic, hospital_lobby, er, dentist, physio, hotel
